quotes.text: ClinEnv is built from MIMIC-IV v3.1 ( Johnson et al., 2023a ) and MIMIC-IV-Note v2.2
making every case fully traceable back to its source EHR

parsed.rationale: The paper names the source datasets with versions and platform via MIMIC/PhysioNet. It also reports retained audit artifacts that trace cases back to source EHR records.
